verdict.rationale: Parahelp's security page says workspace admins can turn off all personal data storage so Parahelp does not retain it. That gives a coarse, all-or-nothing retention control. No other evidence covers configurable retention or deletion. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, on-demand or per-record deletion of stored data (tickets, memory, knowledge), deletion request or erasure workflows, detailed docs on the disable-storage setting, and independent corroboration.
